## Advice to Improve Heart Health and Sleep Regularity
1. Establish a consistent sleep schedule by going to bed before midnight and waking up at the same time daily to regulate your circadian rhythm.
2. Gradually increase your sleep duration to meet the recommended 7–9 hours per night by shifting bedtime 15–30 minutes earlier each week.
3. Improve sleep quality by implementing a relaxing bedtime routine, avoiding screens at least an hour before bed, and ensuring your bedroom is dark, quiet, and cool.
4. Incorporate regular physical activity, aiming for at least 8,000–10,000 steps per day and 150 minutes of moderate exercise weekly, as higher activity levels are linked to better sleep.
5. Schedule a medical evaluation to discuss the detected sleep apnea events and occasional premature beats, and consider a sleep study to assess your cardiovascular risk.
6. Avoid extreme sleep restriction and extended periods of inactivity, as both contribute to poor sleep and potential heart rhythm issues.
7. Practice stress-reducing techniques such as deep breathing, meditation, or gentle yoga to help manage premature beats linked to sleep debt and stress.
8. Use your health tracker to monitor sleep trends and make incremental adjustments, focusing on consistent improvements rather than daily fluctuations.
